title: 第13章 妖邪第14章 银月
content_zh:
对于黄显钧的问题，赵晨很肯定地点点头道：“是的，师傅。”
他刚刚将除了关于“大日星槎”
之外自己这两天所经历，以及推测出的事情，悉数告知了对方。
毕竟从刚刚黄师傅冒险救他的举动来看，这位金镖武馆的馆主虽然有些爱显摆、喜吹牛，人品却还是过硬的，对于自己这个徒弟也是真心爱护的。
“那么就有些问题了……你在家里的卧房还好说，毕竟你以前相当信任那位姨娘，而作为比你大不了几岁的继母，秀凌丫头也不好管你房里的事……至于你爹，就更不会在意后宅一个房间的布置问题……
“但连我这边的房间也被插了手，那可就不一样了。”
黄显钧皱起眉毛，斟酌着说道。
“怎么说？”
赵晨虽然脑子不慢，且已得了原主不少记忆，但到底还是隔了一层，有些事反应不过来。
“你那位姨娘等闲是出不了家门的，想要插手外面的事，必然得找人帮忙……而以秀凌丫头的治家能力，她不可能毫无所觉……而她知道了，也就等于你爹知道了……
“原来如此……难怪李镇守来的那么快！
难怪‘红霞剑’说是应你爹和秀凌丫头的邀请而来。
“他们当是早就发现了……”
说到这里，黄显钧忽然停住，因为他觉得再说下去可能就有搬弄是非，挑动人家家庭不睦的嫌疑在了。
他们早就发现原主身边出现了问题，却放任梅姨娘改动风水格局，侵消原主气数，为方虚子诅咒原主提供基础……
他们是在以儿子的性命为诱饵，想要探明幕后主使的身份和目的。
在心里接上师傅话中的未尽之意后，赵晨在微微有些心凉之余，也为原主感到了些许悲哀。
后妈不亲就算了，亲妈的通房丫鬟想要弄死他也不提，就连亲爹都只想着“钓鱼”
，根本没把他的安危放在心上。
“你父亲当是知道你身怀‘法器’，可以抵挡诅咒，所以才放任了你姨娘的行动……另外，那个梅姨娘毕竟是你亲生母亲身边的丫鬟，你父亲可能也是想找到切实证据后再拿下她，要不然你和你兄长难免会觉得是秀凌那丫头在栽赃陷害。”

黄显钧帮着找了几个理由，算是给了赵晨一些安慰，虽然他心里也不赞同赵嵩的做法。
“师傅……我都理解！”
赵晨点点头，看起来并没有失落或难过的情绪。
他也确实没有那些情绪，毕竟他是“穿”
来的，亲人不“亲”
难道不是好事？
黄显钧不知道赵晨心中所想，怜悯地看了他一眼后，转移话题道：“我猜你那位姨娘背后很可能是‘心光寺’的妖人在搞鬼。”
“‘心光寺’？”
content_en:
Regarding Huang Xianjun's question, Zhao Chen nodded firmly and said: "Yes, master."
He has just added some information about the "Great Sun Star"
In addition, he told the other party everything he had experienced in the past two days, as well as what he had speculated.
After all, judging from Master Huang's risk-taking action to save him just now, although the owner of the Golden Dart Martial Arts School likes to show off and brag, he still has a good character and truly cares for his apprentice.
"Then there are some problems... Your bedroom at home is okay. After all, you used to trust that aunt quite a lot, and as a stepmother who is only a few years older than you, Xiuling girl can't take care of things in your room... As for your father, he doesn't even care about the layout of a room in the back house...
“But if even my side of the room is involved, that’s different. "
Huang Xianjun frowned and said thoughtfully.
"How to say? "
Although Zhao Chen is not slow in thinking and has gained a lot of memories from the original owner, he is still separated by a layer and cannot react to some things.
"Your aunt can't leave the house. If she wants to interfere in outside affairs, she must find someone to help... And with Xiuling's ability to manage the family, she can't be unaware... And if she knows, it means your father knows...
"I see... No wonder Li Zhenshou came so quickly!
No wonder ‘Hongxia Sword’ said that he came at the invitation of your father and girl Xiu Ling.
"They must have discovered it long ago..."
At this point, Huang Xianjun suddenly stopped because he felt that if he continued talking, he might be suspected of stirring up trouble and stirring up family disharmony.
They had long discovered that there was a problem with the original owner, but they allowed Aunt Mei to change the Feng Shui pattern, destroy the original owner's Qi, and provide the basis for Fang Xuzi to curse the original owner...
They were using their son's life as bait to find out the identity and purpose of the mastermind behind the scenes.
After receiving the unfinished meaning of the master's words in his heart, Zhao Chen felt a little sad and felt a little sad for the original owner.
It’s okay if his stepmother doesn’t kiss him, and he doesn’t even mention it when his biological mother’s maid wants to kill him. Even his biological father only thinks about “fishing”
, not caring about his safety at all.
"Your father must have known that you had a 'magic weapon' that could withstand the curse, so he allowed your aunt to act... In addition, after all, Aunt Mei is the maid of your biological mother. Your father may also want to find tangible evidence before taking her down. Otherwise, you and your brother will inevitably feel that it is Xiuling who is framing her. "
Huang Xianjun helped find a few reasons, which gave Zhao Chen some comfort, although he didn't agree with Zhao Song's approach in his heart.
"Master...I understand everything! "
Zhao Chen nodded, not looking disappointed or sad.
He does not have those emotions, after all, he is "wearing"
Come, relatives are not "kissing"
Isn't that a good thing?
Huang Xianjun didn't know what Zhao Chen was thinking. After giving him a pitiful look, he changed the subject and said, "I guess the monster from the Xinguang Temple is behind your aunt. "
"'Xinguang Temple'? "
